chain.title: An Adventurer's Ledger
chain.desc: Sold by the Gatekeeper, the villager who lives in the overworld house that generates with both unlit Blue Skies portals; using it once unlocks the journal tab.

chain.title: Spark for Two Skies
chain.desc: Also sold by the Gatekeeper, and craftable from a Charoite and a Moonstone Shard once you have them; it is the only thing that ignites either portal.

chain.title: The Endless Noon
chain.desc: Entered through a Turquoise Stone Brick frame lit with a Zeal Lighter; the dimension is locked to daytime and permanently cold.

chain.title: Red Metal of the Cold World
chain.desc: Smelted from Ventium Ore or Raw Ventium; the Everbright's iron equivalent and the metal behind buckets, shears and the Tool Box.

chain.title: The Bench That Rebuilds
chain.desc: Crafted from Ventium ingots and planks; it upgrades tool durability and swaps the stick on any Blue Skies tool for a different wood.

chain.title: Chip of a Wicked Soul
chain.desc: Dropped by the Everbright's Frost Spirits and Polargeists and found in village temple chests; it is also a piglin repellent.

chain.title: The Lying Ore
chain.desc: Smelted from Falsite Ore, and the Tool Box reagent that adds durability to almost any Everbright or Everdawn tool.

chain.title: Nothing Spawns Here
chain.desc: Crafted from a Seclam's Pearl, a Soul Fragment and Falsite nuggets; placed, it suppresses hostile spawns over a wide radius.

chain.title: Cooking by Cold
chain.desc: Built from a Snowcap Mushroom Block, Turquoise Cobblestone and a furnace; it cooks by draining heat and leaves a frozen byproduct.

chain.title: Forever at Sunrise
chain.desc: Entered through a Lunar Stone Brick frame lit with the same Zeal Lighter; hot, humid, locked at sunrise and crawling with oversized insects.

chain.title: Metal That Refuses to Cool
chain.desc: Smelted from Horizonite Ore in the Crystal Dunes; tools made from it auto-smelt the ores they break.

chain.title: A Furnace With No Fire
chain.desc: Crafted from Horizonite ingots, Lunar Cobblestone and a furnace; it smelts without fuel, recharging from Horizonite items or Sunstone Crystals.

chain.title: Light Under Both Skies
chain.desc: Mined from the Moonstone Ore of either dimension; the mod's own advancement tree treats holding one as the gate to the whole gemstone ladder.

chain.title: Fast, Fragile, First
chain.desc: The lowest gem tier of both worlds - tools swing very quickly but wear out fast and cannot mine Diopside or Charoite.

chain.title: The Aqua Standard
chain.desc: The iron-equivalent gem of the Blue Skies, notably more enchantable than the tiers around it.

chain.title: Green and Merciless
chain.desc: A deep-underground gem whose gear is the most durable in either dimension; the tools hit hardest but swing slowest.

chain.title: The Violet Answer
chain.desc: The diamond-equivalent gem and the top of the harvest ladder - only Charoite tools can mine everything found in these worlds.

chain.title: Four to Open the Tower
chain.desc: Looted from the library, study and prison chests of either Blinding Dungeon; four of them at the top-floor Keystone open the boss room.

chain.title: The Illager Who Calls
chain.desc: The Everbright Blinding Dungeon boss; his loot bags carry the Ethereal Arc, the Summoning Tome and the Soulbound Spear.

chain.title: Transmuter of Two Worlds
chain.desc: The Everdawn Blinding Dungeon boss; his loot bags carry the Dusk Arc, the Alchemy Table and the Alchemy Scroll.

chain.title: Key to the Green Pyramid
chain.desc: Found on each floor of the Nature Dungeon, the stone pyramid that only becomes relevant after the Summoner falls.

chain.title: Held Together by Vines
chain.desc: The Nature Dungeon boss, a golem of dungeon stone and Starlit vine; it drops the Nature Arc and the Crushing Hammer.

chain.title: Key to the Webbed Tree
chain.desc: Found on each floor of the Poison Dungeon, the spider nest hidden inside a webbed tree in the Sunset Maple Forest.

chain.title: Mother of the Nest
chain.desc: The Poison Dungeon boss and the mod's final fight; it drops the Poison Arc, the Venom Sac and the Different Sword.

notes: Item set = the 700 stems of assets/blue_skies/models/item/*.json intersected with item.blue_skies.* / block.blue_skies.* keys across every assets/*/lang/en_us.json in the jar (the jar ships three en_us files: assets/blue_skies/lang, assets/blue_skies/blue_skies/journal_lang and a legacy_pack copy); every blue_skies: id above is a member of that set. Ordering is taken straight from data/blue_skies/advancements: root -> everbright/enter and everdawn/enter -> get_wood -> {get_ventium -> use_tool_box -> use_falsite_in_tool_box, get_falsite, craft_snowcap_oven, kill_summoner -> enter_nature_dungeon -> kill_starlit_crusher} and {get_horizonite -> craft_horizonite_forge, kill_alchemist -> use_alchemy_table / enter_poison_dungeon -> kill_arachnarch}; the shared gem ladder is get_moonstone_shard -> get_pyrope -> get_aquite -> {get_diopside, get_charoite}. Both dimensions confirmed from data/blue_skies/dimension/everbright.json and everdawn.json (the only two dimension files). Portal frames and the Gatekeeper are confirmed by the mod's own JEI info strings: gui.blue_skies.jei.info.turquoise_stonebrick / lunar_stonebrick name the two frame blocks, gui.blue_skies.jei.info.portal says the portal generates in The Gatekeeper's house and is lit with a Zeal Lighter, and gui.blue_skies.jei.info.blue_journal / zeal_lighter say both are sold by The Gatekeeper. All four bosses are verified twice over - each has a loot table in data/blue_skies/loot_tables/entities/ and its own loot_bags/<boss>/{common,uncommon,rare}.json - so the four kill: steps cannot be dead ends. CONSENSUS CONFLICT (moddb): moddb lists blue_skies:raw_charoite at pos 0.341, but data/blue_skies/advancements/get_charoite.json gates on blue_skies:charoite, the smelted gem, and the whole gem ladder (pyrope/aquite/diopside) is expressed in cut gems. Graph preferred: raw_charoite dropped in favour of charoite. moddb also lists blue_skies:lunar_stonebrick and blue_skies:bluebright_pickaxe (2 packs each) and blue_skies:food_prep_table (5 packs); all three are real ids in the jar but sit off the advancement spine, so they were left out of the 24-step chain rather than displacing a gate. Dropped, unverifiable: blue_skies:arc_furnace (no model, no lang key - not in this version). Entities present in lang but with no loot table are all projectiles or props (decaying_spike, ent_leaf, ent_root, ent_wall, fluctuant_sphere, seed_bomb, strange_lightning, venom_bomb, venom_spit) plus the jelly_drifter.color.* subkeys; none were used as kill targets. Wheel 3 collects the four dungeon Arcs and the boss loot-bag treasures - every member is verified in loot_tables/loot_bags/<boss>/*.json except different_sword, which is in the arachnarch bags.
